name: Minimal Nordic
description: A compact low-ornament compass card with a restrained teal wind spear.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Every texture except the ring is optional; a missing one falls back to primitive geometry with identical motion, so a partial skin degrades in appearance only. The centred canvas is what lets the wind rune orbit outside the rim through the same rotation transform every other layer uses.

orientationConventions.model: North-up. Every indicator is handed an absolute world bearing and rendered at z = -bearing. The card rests on north and only a storm turns it.
orientationConventions.ring: The compass card, carrying the north/south reference. North is at 12 o'clock in the source texture. It rests unrotated; storm interference is the only thing that ever moves it. Keep it visually subordinate - it is background, not the primary read.
orientationConventions.cameraWedge: Optional. A quiet background sector showing where the camera looks, drawn around the canvas centre and pointing to 12 o'clock at bearing 0. Keep it low-contrast; it must not compete with the character arrow. Omit the key and the mod draws two faint edge ticks instead.
orientationConventions.characterArrow: Optional. The prominent central arrow showing which way the CHARACTER faces - the compass's primary read, and the boldest thing on the dial. Tip points to 12 o'clock at bearing 0, mounted at the canvas centre. Omit the key for a primitive arrow.
orientationConventions.windGust: Optional. A SMALL gust rune that orbits OUTSIDE the rim at the bearing the wind blows toward. Draw it centred on its own canvas; the mod offsets it to the orbit radius, so the art needs no knowledge of where the rim is. Keep it well under the character arrow's visual weight - roughly a third. Wind never suffers storm interference: the instrument fails, the weather you can see does not.
orientationConventions.windPointer: Superseded. The centre-mounted wind pointer was replaced by the external orbiting gust rune; this key is still read but nothing mounts it. Use windGustTexture.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Superseded. Under north-up there is no fixed lubber line - the character arrow carries facing. Use characterArrowTexture.
